comment: Honestly one of the best professors at the University of Richmond. He understands how to successful and efficiently manage class. I hope everyone takes him at some point .
Doctor Mew is an inspiration to everyone!!
The goat. No questions asked. Pay attention on the first day of class bc the final presentation Lowkey on that

Take this FYS, it is the easiest one at U of R. Felt like a middle school class. You almost always get out of class after 20 minutes. Attendance is also not mandatory. However, he doesn't grade anything until the last week of school, and I learned nothing from the class. Grades are based off three papers, and random HW assignments he rarely posts.

This class is probably the easiest FYS at UR. However, if you're the type of student to really care about due dates and assignments, Dr. Mew posts things so infrequently that I was stressing out about a lack of guidelines and grades. No real grades were posted for the semester until finals week.

Take this class if you want an easy FYS. Dr. Mew is a friendly person and classes aren't stressful. If you're interested in boats and naval strategy you'll enjoy talking to him. Not many assignments (he forgets to post them most of the time) but his grading criteria is impossible to understand. Not a harsh grader and participation isn't graded.

Professor Mew does not do a good job of explaining things. For knowledge management 2 he used 3 books that werent even relevant to the class. He acts like youre stupid if you dont understand something that hes saying, and is very judgmental of people who take longer to learn things than others. 0/10 would not take again
He does not help you understand the material that is assigned. Personally I would not take him again, because he is not clear on what to do.  Oh yeah, he curses in class too. Be warned.

Mr.Mew is the kind of teacher that is knowledgable of the subject he teaches but cant communicate it well. He needs more structure and organizational skills.I did not understand his instructions. He does asks students if they need help to contact him, but I contacted him and he didnt help with anything. Be prepared to learn independently.

Very relaxed classroom atmosphere. We were essentially getting away with murder this semester. Some FYS's were insanely difficult. Not this one. No tests or quizzes. Didn't check once to see if we read the books. Only a few papers that most people wrote the night before. You could write the papers without doing a lick of reading and get an A.
